heightPolicy: No measured DEM bundled in this detail pack; existing base shape and relief are not promoted into detail.

provenance.citation: NASA Uranus–Ariel 3-D resource, USGS mosaic using Voyager imagery; credit USGS/Tammy Becker and JPL/Caltech
provenance.coverage: Voyager 2's mapped coverage is concentrated in the encountered southern hemisphere; the official texture's unmapped/low-confidence regions are retained rather than replaced with invented imagery.
provenance.license: NASA/JPL/Caltech and USGS public mission imagery; retain attribution.
provenance.processing: Pinned 2048x1024 NASA WebP; verified 8-bit sRGB 3-channel metadata; resized without reprojection to 512x256, 1024x512 and native 2048x1024 JPEG derivatives; color is never used to derive height.
provenance.orientationEvidence: NASA labels this asset an image texture for 3D models, but the published source metadata does not specify prime meridian, east/west sign, or pole orientation. The script validates dimensions/channels and preserves the supplied pixel order without a flip or rotate; alignment is explicitly unverified.
provenance.proceduralHeight: Seamless direction-vector field, little-endian uint16, height = -500 + sample x 1 m; bounded range is recorded per level; synthetic approximation only.

processing: Pixel-centered canonical east-positive imagery sampled bilinearly at native resolution (maximum 64 ppd); 512-pixel bounded JPEG tiles; 70-degree stereographic polar replacement, square equatorial ground spacing; little-endian uint16 scientific heights in lossless gzip. Polar imagery remains limited by native polar observations/fill.
